name: definition-year-number-collision-across-change
description: Invalid definition (fiscalclock 0.2.0). Calendar years change to 1 July years through a six-month transition, 2024-01-01 to 2024-06-30. Numbered by 'start', the transition and the year from 1 July 2024 both get 2024, so the number does not increase across the change. Only code and path are asserted; details.years is not.
